verdict.rationale: cubic's docs say that once the app is installed it automatically reviews new pull requests on GitHub. It comments on bugs and improvements in the PR, supports replying to its review comments, and can auto-resolve threads when issues are fixed. This is the core GitHub-app inline-review workflow, and the quickstart promises getting started 'in minutes.' missing for 10: an explicit statement that comments are posted as line-level inline review comments, documented turnaround time for a standard review (only Ultrareview timing is given), GitLab support, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
